AC Amendment (gap analysis finding 4 — symmetric to finding 3): $PLUGIN_SCRIPTS resolution gap.

CRITICAL: Same resolution requirement as task-3. Before inserting the CHANNEL= line into the debug-everything SKILL.md bash block, confirm that $PLUGIN_SCRIPTS is already defined. The task description already includes a fallback resolution line — ensure it is included:
```bash
PLUGIN_SCRIPTS="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso}/scripts"
```

Then:
```bash
CHANNEL=$(DSO_FILING_CONTEXT=debug-everything bash "$PLUGIN_SCRIPTS/infer-detected-by.sh" 2>/dev/null || echo "other")
```

The resolution preamble in task-3 and task-4 MUST be identical to prevent divergence between the two callers.
